verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since a state business-filing portal has a sign-in path whose verification method is a fair question. However, the evidence only shows Akamai and Incapsula bot walls on robots.txt for www.nvsos.gov and esos.nv.gov/orion.nv.gov. Nothing documents whether sign-in uses remotely completable credential MFA, biometric liveness, in-person visits, or mailed PINs, so the capability is unevidenced.
